scope: Independent blinded evaluation using only requests.txt, rubric.json, and blinded/Cedar.md, blinded/Maple.md, blinded/Birch.md. No other pilot files, product repository, source text, web, specialist skills, or arm identities were consulted.
scoring_method: Frozen 20-criterion rubric; 0 absent/materially incorrect, 1 partial/ambiguous, 2 clear/correct/applicable. Scores concern response content; citation presence does not contribute to or subtract from rubric scores.

material_errors: No material incorrect systems-design claim identified in the allowed response texts. Full marks mean criteria were explicitly met, not that implementation or operational behavior was demonstrated.

limitations: One trial per arm; no repeatability estimate.
Tasks and rubric were author-created, not an independently sampled benchmark.
Reasoning-only evaluation: no production, load, broker, billing-sink, or disaster-recovery behavior was exercised.
Only partial blinding: citations may reveal source access. Arm identities were not inferred or assigned.
Rubric totals are near the ceiling and do not capture every difference in engineering detail.
No statistical or production superiority claim is supported.
